ALTER TABLE student_learning_action
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS evidence_class varchar(32) NULL,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS outcome varchar(16) NULL,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS outcome_policy_version varchar(64) NULL;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_action
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_learning_action_evidence_class_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_learning_action_outcome_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_learning_action_outcome_policy_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_learning_action_open_outcome_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_learning_action_closed_outcome_check;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_action
    ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_action_evidence_class_check
        CHECK (evidence_class IS NULL OR evidence_class IN ('knowledge_check', 'application')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_action_outcome_check
        CHECK (outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('passed', 'failed')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_action_outcome_policy_check
        CHECK (
            (outcome IS NULL AND outcome_policy_version IS NULL)
            OR
            (outcome IS NOT NULL AND outcome_policy_version = 'student-mastery-v1')
        ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_action_open_outcome_check
        CHECK (closed_at IS NOT NULL OR (outcome IS NULL AND outcome_policy_version IS NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_action_closed_outcome_check
        CHECK (
            closed_at IS NULL
            OR
            (outcome IS NOT NULL AND outcome_policy_version = 'student-mastery-v1')
        ) NOT VALID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_action_target_evidence (
    learning_action_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_learning_action(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_class varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    outcome varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    support_context varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    evidence_kind varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    hints_used integer NOT NULL CHECK (hints_used BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
    max_hint_level smallint NULL CHECK (max_hint_level BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
    intervention_used boolean NOT NULL,
    teacher_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    mastery_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (learning_action_id, target_type, target_key, target_version),
    CHECK (target_type IN ('concept', 'capability')),
    CHECK (btrim(target_key) <> ''),
    CHECK (evidence_class IN ('knowledge_check', 'application')),
    CHECK (outcome IN ('passed', 'failed')),
    CHECK (support_context IN ('independent', 'guided')),
    CHECK (
        evidence_kind IN (
            'failed_knowledge_check',
            'assisted_understanding',
            'independent_understanding',
            'failed_application',
            'assisted_application',
            'independent_application'
        )
    ),
    CHECK (
        (outcome = 'failed' AND evidence_kind IN ('failed_knowledge_check', 'failed_application'))
        OR
        (outcome = 'passed' AND evidence_kind NOT IN ('failed_knowledge_check', 'failed_application'))
    ),
    CHECK (
        (evidence_class = 'knowledge_check' AND evidence_kind IN ('failed_knowledge_check', 'assisted_understanding', 'independent_understanding'))
        OR
        (evidence_class = 'application' AND evidence_kind IN ('failed_application', 'assisted_application', 'independent_application'))
    ),
    CHECK (
        evidence_kind NOT IN ('independent_understanding', 'independent_application')
        OR support_context = 'independent'
    ),
    CHECK (
        evidence_kind NOT IN ('assisted_understanding', 'assisted_application')
        OR support_context = 'guided'
    ),
    CHECK (
        (hints_used = 0 AND max_hint_level IS NULL)
        OR
        (hints_used > 0 AND max_hint_level IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CHECK (btrim(teacher_policy_version) <> ''),
    CHECK (mastery_policy_version = 'student-mastery-v1')
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_action_target_evidence_target_idx
    ON student_learning_action_target_evidence (
        student_id,
        target_type,
        target_key,
        target_version,
        occurred_at DESC
    );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_target_mastery (
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    state varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    mastery_score numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    confidence numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    independent_success_count integer NOT NULL,
    assisted_success_count integer NOT NULL,
    failure_count integer NOT NULL,
    evidence_count integer NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    last_practiced_at timestamptz NULL,
    last_failed_at timestamptz NULL,
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (student_id, target_type, target_key, target_version),
    CHECK (target_type IN ('concept', 'capability')),
    CHECK (btrim(target_key) <> ''),
    CHECK (state IN ('UNKNOWN', 'EXPOSED', 'UNDERSTOOD', 'PRACTICED', 'APPLIED', 'MASTERED')),
    CHECK (mastery_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    CHECK (independent_success_count >= 0),
    CHECK (assisted_success_count >= 0),
    CHECK (failure_count >= 0),
    CHECK (evidence_count > 0),
    CHECK (independent_success_count + assisted_success_count + failure_count = evidence_count),
    CHECK (last_practiced_at IS NULL OR last_practiced_at <= last_seen_at),
    CHECK (last_failed_at IS NULL OR last_failed_at <= last_seen_at),
    CHECK (policy_version = 'student-mastery-v1')
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_target_mastery_audit (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    learning_action_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_learning_action(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_kind varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    previous_state varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    next_state varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    previous_mastery_score numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    next_mastery_score numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    previous_confidence numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    next_confidence numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    reason_code varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    evidence_occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    processed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (learning_action_id, target_type, target_key, target_version, policy_version),
    CHECK (target_type IN ('concept', 'capability')),
    CHECK (btrim(target_key) <> ''),
    CHECK (previous_state IN ('UNKNOWN', 'EXPOSED', 'UNDERSTOOD', 'PRACTICED', 'APPLIED', 'MASTERED')),
    CHECK (next_state IN ('UNKNOWN', 'EXPOSED', 'UNDERSTOOD', 'PRACTICED', 'APPLIED', 'MASTERED')),
    CHECK (previous_mastery_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    CHECK (next_mastery_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    CHECK (previous_confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    CHECK (next_confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    CHECK (btrim(reason_code) <> ''),
    CHECK (policy_version = 'student-mastery-v1')
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS student_target_mastery_audit_target_idx
    ON student_target_mastery_audit (
        student_id,
        target_type,
        target_key,
        target_version,
        evidence_occurred_at DESC
    );
